name: mcps
description: Meta-MCP registry and CLI. Discovers, manages, and proxies MCP servers from a local SQLite registry; ships a CLI, an MCP server, and an SDK. PostgreSQL is a push/pull synchronization boundary only, never the runtime backend.

waivedStorageEngines.reason: mcps owns a local SQLite registry only; resolveStorageMode() accepts the local backend alone and PostgreSQL appears solely as an optional push/pull synchronization target in src/lib/storage-sync.ts.
